facts.fact: Finlay 走后她关掉锅炉自罚——她知道自己要沉底一段时间。
facts.anchor: I flicked the switch to the boiler, turning it off. I knew where I was headed, was all too aware that I wouldn’t be surfacing from my bed for some time.

facts.fact: 她注销了 Natters with Nova 的整个 Facebook 页面，掐断所有生意入口。
facts.anchor: I even thought I’d successfully put a stop to any new enquiries by disabling my Facebook page entirely

facts.fact: 那条私信申请来自 THE Finlay Munro 本人。
facts.anchor: the brand-new message request from none other than THE Finlay Munro.

facts.fact: 他的开场白竟是「你可能不记得我」——两周前才见过的人。
facts.anchor: I’m not sure if you’ll remember me, but I just wanted to thank you for the reading.

facts.fact: 第二条消息挑明：想再见一面，喝一杯？
facts.anchor: …I’d really like to see you again. Do you fancy a drink sometime?

facts.fact: 她的道德清算：让他相信他女友死了的那一刻，背叛的不止是他，还有她自己。
facts.anchor: I knew, deep down, the minute I allowed Finlay to believe his girlfriend was dead, I’d be betraying not only him but myself.

facts.fact: 随手翻到的 Hafiz 诗句叫她「快跑」——她却读成了「奔向他」。
facts.anchor: ‘Run, my dear, from anything that may not strengthen your precious, budding wings.’ – Hafiz.

facts.fact: 他澄清：不是再约解读——明知不合适，还是想「见见面」。
facts.anchor: I didn’t actually mean another reading. I know it’s wild and really inappropriate considering the circumstances but…I just thought we could hang out?
